# VR Duct — AR/VR, VFX & 360 Video
> London-based studio serving the UK & worldwide. We design and produce VR, AR, MR, VFX, 360 video, and interactive 3D experiences.

Core notes: London HQ; bespoke immersive development and production; enterprise and SMB clients.

## Services
- [Virtual Reality (VR)](https://www.vrduct.com/virtual-reality-vr-development/): Custom VR apps, training, simulations
- [Augmented Reality (AR)](https://www.vrduct.com/augmented-reality-development/): Markerless/marker-based AR for mobile & wearables
- [Mixed Reality (MR)](https://www.vrduct.com/mixed-reality-mr-development/): Spatial computing experiences blending digital+physical
- [360 VR Live Streaming](https://www.vrduct.com/360-vr-live-streaming/): Live 360° broadcasts and events
- [3D Virtual Tours](https://www.vrduct.com/3d-360-virtual-tours/): Interactive tours for property, venues, and museums
- [3D Architectural Renderings](https://www.vrduct.com/3d-architectural-renderings/): Photoreal stills/animations for design review & marketing
- [Video Production](https://www.vrduct.com/video-production-service-uk-international/): End-to-end production for brand and product stories
- [Visual Effects (VFX)](https://www.vrduct.com/visual-effects-vfx-immersive-content/): On-brand CG, compositing, motion design
- [VR Arcade / LBE](https://www.vrduct.com/vr-arcade-game-arenas-lbe-development/): Location-based entertainment design & development
- [Metaverse Development](https://www.vrduct.com/metaverse-development-company/): Persistent 3D spaces and events

## Projects
- [Virtual Horizons — VR Experience](https://www.vrduct.com/project/virtual-horizons-vr-experience/): Immersive exploration demo
- [Radiant Quest — AR Gamified](https://www.vrduct.com/project/radiant-quest-ar-gamified/): Branded AR gameplay for engagement
